scope: Autonomous themed expansion series beginning with Travel. Counts are cumulative across its review branches, not a diff against the current PR base. Pre-existing beginner content and reference dictionary inventories are excluded from new-vocabulary totals.

countingRules.newDistinctVocabulary: Unique visible base lexical entry IDs introduced by the named theme. Hidden readings, inflected support records, characters, definitions, examples and localized usage-note text are excluded.
countingRules.grammaticalForms: Unique nonempty entryId/setId/path recording bindings attached to those new base words; forms are not counted as new vocabulary.
countingRules.examples: Independently authored composite sentence cards in the named theme files. Reused sentences in other decks do not add new examples.
countingRules.libraryRecords: Current total seed content records of all classes, shown only as a separate inventory measure.
